# Reesol Mart

> Reesol Mart is a Kenyan supplier of swimming pool equipment, solar water heating systems, water pumps, water filtration products, plumbing supplies, and water treatment solutions for residential, commercial, industrial, and hospitality projects.

Site: https://reesolmart.com
Language: English
Geographic coverage: Kenya and East Africa
